annotation.title_clean: India Takes the Lead: Establishing the IndiaAI Safety Institute for Responsible AI Innovation
annotation.title_en: India Takes the Lead: Establishing the IndiaAI Safety Institute for Responsible AI Innovation
annotation.summary_en: Government announcement (Jan 2025) that India's MeitY will set up the IndiaAI Safety Institute under the Safe and Trusted pillar of the IndiaAI Mission, alongside GPU empanelment and foundational model calls. It uses a hub-and-spoke model and funds responsible AI projects. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: IndiaAI Safety Institute to be established under the Safe and Trusted pillar of the IndiaAI Mission
Hub-and-spoke model with academic, research and private partners
Research based on Indian datasets, contextualised to India's diversity
Eight Responsible AI projects selected; second Expression of Interest launched covering AI risk assessment and management
Announced 18,000+ GPUs and a call for indigenous foundational models
